THE POOLED NUMBER WAS THE REGRESSION. THE ROLE SPLIT IS NOT. Two findings, and they
do not conflict -- the second explains the first.
1. loop_cancer's 0.2990 is withdrawn. With no regression anywhere, pooled
essentiality sits at 0.4949 inside a band of 0.5190. The blanket claim that
the model predicts non-drivers was manufactured by partialling out a confound
that predicts the label at 0.8259.
2. The two driver roles point OPPOSITE WAYS and cancel. Loss-of-function drivers are
less essential than their matched controls (0.4717); activating drivers are MORE
essential (0.5248); the gap of +0.0531 beats permuting role with the pairs
held fixed (+0.0406). A pooled test over both roles has to read as nothing,
because it is averaging a constraint against its opposite.
That is the survivability constraint showing up exactly where it should: a tumour
suppressor has to be deletable, so it cannot be essential; an oncogene is switched on
rather than lost, so nothing stops it from being essential. THE MARGIN IS THIN -- one
test, ~160 pairs a side, and a difference that clears its permutation band by 0.0125.
It is a direction worth one more measurement, not a result to build on.
